concepts.name: Privirea
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one exceptionally refined minimalist logo concept for the Romanian civic monitoring website "lastraja.ro". It tracks Parliament and Senate activity, representatives' speeches and future legislative actions. Brand idea: an attentive independent civic observer, calm, sharp, trustworthy.
DIRECTION 1 — THE WATCHFUL EYE. Design a very simple, distinctive abstract eye symbol using two clean asymmetric arcs and one solid circular pupil, with one purposeful open gap. It should feel like a brilliant modern design studio identity, readable as a tiny favicon. Pair the symbol on the left with a carefully spaced contemporary lowercase sans-serif wordmark, clean humanist proportions, medium weight. Exact wordmark, verbatim: "lastraja.ro". All eleven characters must be correct: l a s t r a j a . r o.
Use a single dark ink color, flat on an untextured light background. Landscape canvas with the horizontal lockup centered, generous whitespace, the logo large enough to judge. Beautiful optical alignment, bespoke proportions, crisp vector-like edges.
This is a finished logo presentation, not a website mockup or a moodboard. No slogan, no headings, no concept number, no explanatory text, no decorative lines, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no mockup objects. Avoid security shield, CCTV, political party imagery, national flag and ornate civic crests. Only the mark and the exact wordmark.

concepts.name: Agora
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create one exceptionally refined minimalist logo concept for "lastraja.ro", a Romanian independent website following Parliament and Senate, speeches, votes and upcoming legislation.
DIRECTION 2 — THE CIVIC CONVERSATION. Invent a bold compact geometric symbol based on a parliamentary hemicycle / semicircular seating arrangement that simultaneously reads as a speech bubble through negative space. Use just a few strong geometric pieces: an outer semicircular arc and two inner seats or segments, with one short asymmetric speech tail integrated into the base. Radically economical, instantly recognizable, not a detailed illustration of a building. It must remain clear at favicon size. Pair it with a rounded yet mature lowercase geometric sans-serif wordmark with excellent spacing. Exact text, verbatim: "lastraja.ro" (l a s t r a j a . r o). The icon on the left, wordmark on the right.
Let this concept have one confident single accent color suitable for a contemporary civic platform, on a plain very light background. Flat solid shapes, no gradients or effects. Landscape canvas, beautifully centered logo lockup, ample whitespace. Premium design studio level, intentional optical balance.
Only one logo, no alternatives within the image, no slogan, no annotations, no titles, no labels, no interface or stationery mockup. Avoid eyes, shields, watchtowers, flags, generic chat-app bubbles, microphones, clip art and thin fussy strokes. This must be structurally distinct from an eye logo or a traditional editorial wordmark.

concepts.name: Editorial
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Design one stunning minimalist typographic identity for "lastraja.ro", an independent Romanian civic journalism / parliamentary monitoring platform covering representatives' speeches and upcoming legislative activity.
DIRECTION 3 — THE INDEPENDENT EDITORIAL. The wordmark itself is the whole logo: no separate symbol. Use a bespoke expressive contemporary editorial serif in lowercase, confident medium-to-bold weight, distinctive but very readable, balanced thick and thin strokes, tasteful sharp details. Create a clever, subtle custom connection or distinctive cut in the "st" or "j" so the wordmark has a memorable proprietary character. The ".ro" should belong elegantly to the same wordmark, slightly more restrained. Exact text only, verbatim: "lastraja.ro". Spell it correctly: l a s t r a j a . r o. No spaces, no diacritics.
Aim for the sophistication of an independent cultural journal crossed with a sharp civic publication. Strong, compact horizontal wordmark, generous negative space around it, black or near-black ink on a plain warm light ground. Flat crisp vector-like artwork, beautifully controlled kerning and baseline. Landscape canvas.
Only a single typographic logo, large and centered. No eye, no parliament graphic, no speech bubble, no shield, no separate icon, no underline, no decorative badge, no slogan, no concept title, no labels, no palette swatches, no website or print mockups, no texture, no shadows, no gradients, no 3D. Radically different from geometric symbol-plus-sans-serif logos.
